name: List IAM Users
description: List all IAM users in the AWS tenant, with optional filtering by path prefix.

path_prefix.description: The path prefix to filter users by (e.g. '/division_abc/subdivision_xyz/'). Defaults to '/' to return all users.

users.description: List of IAM users in the AWS tenant.

user_id.description: The stable and unique string identifying the user.

user_name.description: The friendly name identifying the user.

arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the user.

create_date.description: The date and time when the user was created (ISO 8601).

password_last_used.description: The date and time when the user's password was last used to sign in (ISO 8601).

count.description: Total number of IAM users returned.
